The narrower defense is that the existing evidence can support certification only in a caveated posture, and that this should not automatically escalate if the finding is framed that way.

It bars certification without material caveats unless there is current evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
